A [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] '''executive''' was the highest ranking officer at the company's immense facility on [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]], responsible for all operations and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] production in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="sb" /> where the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] intersected.<ref>The official name of the sector where the [[Byblos system/Legends|Byblos system]] belonged was not named in canonical sources, however according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|its online companion]], it was situated in the Slice part of the Colonies.</ref>

In his household, he owned the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Perit]], who served hid dutifully but also showed a talent in technology; soon he put him as his personal assistant.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
